create_TAPNet_model: create a TAPNet model instance with configurable feature grid stride, num_heads, and num_frames
run_TAPNet_forward_pass: run a forward pass of TAPNet on video frames with query points to predict tracks and occlusion
compute_tracks_from_cost_volume: compute point tracks and occlusion logits from interpolated features and a cost volume
create_batch_norm_layer: create a Haiku batch normalization layer with configurable cross-replica axis for TSM-ResNet
extract_feature_grid_with_TSM_ResNet: extract normalized feature grids from video input using TSM-ResNet backbone
